definitions.explanation: Humble term used when referring to one's own mother when speaking to others outside the family.

examples.japanese: {母|はは}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: My mother is good at cooking.

examples.english: I gave a present on Mother's Day.
examples.notes: {母|はは}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ = Mother's Day

examples.japanese: {母|はは}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{起|お}きて→起きる：00521_okiru⟧、⟦{朝|あさ}ごはん→朝ご飯：02843_asagohan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}って→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦くれます→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: My mother gets up early every morning and makes breakfast for me.

examples.japanese: {母|はは}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧、⟦{心配|しんぱい}→心配：00811_shinpai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦つかなかった→付く：01960_tsuku⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{急|いそ}いで→急ぐ：01191_isogu⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}って→乗る：00511_noru⟧⟦{実家|じっか}→実家：03076_jikka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}りました→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: When I heard my mother was sick, I was so worried that I couldn't concentrate on work, so I hurried onto a train and went back to my parents' house.

notes:
{母|はは} is the humble term for "mother," used when referring to one's own mother when speaking to people outside the family.

POLITENESS SYSTEM:
- {母|はは}: my mother (humble, to outsiders)
- ⟦お{母|かあ}さん→お母さん：02851_okaasan⟧: mother (neutral, direct address or others' mothers)
- ⟦お{母|かあ}さま→お母様：noentry⟧: mother (very polite/formal)
- ⟦ママ→ママ：03155_mama⟧: mom (casual, childish)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {母|はは}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧: Mother's Day
- {母|はは}⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧: mother (formal/written)
- ⟦{母国|ぼこく}→母国：17954_bokoku⟧: motherland, home country

USAGE NOTE: In casual family settings, children may call their mother ⟦お{母|かあ}さん→お母さん：02851_okaasan⟧ or ⟦ママ→ママ：03155_mama⟧. {母|はは} is specifically for humble reference when talking to outsiders.

RELATED: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧ (father - humble)
